crossRefs.note: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.
The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.
Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you…
Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his house…
The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request…

translations.web: If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.
translations.bsb: If he says, ‘Good,’ then your servant is safe, but if he is enraged, you will know he has evil intentions.
translations.kjv: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
translations.asv: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be wroth, then know that evil is determined by him.
